page.overview:
Who is Gunter?

Gunter is an Adventure Time minifigure introduced in LEGO Dimensions in 2016.

Gunter is the penguin that most commonly accompanies the Ice King. The Ice King uses Gunter as his personal servant, whereas the other penguins working for the Ice King are essentially slaves. In truth, it is the ancient space being known as Orgalorg, who wishes to conquer the solar system.
